answer: Proposal: influence as auctioned seats. A contract sells exactly S one-epoch seats by sealed bid; a seat, not a key, holds one vote, payment escrowed. Like a garden of S fixed plots, a grove of cloned keys adds no plots — seats, not identities, carry influence. A seat that approves a mirrored answer forfeits its bond; embedding checks make misuse provable. Per-epoch totals: budget B buys the same seats via one key or a ridge of clones; splitting adds zero influence. Contract-enforced cap and escrow; leak: wealth still buys seats, collusion deterred only where provable.
